* 图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）。
description.en:
* This field and the body field are mutually exclusive—you cannot pass through both or leave both empty.  
* Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes; base64 is not supported).

description.zh:
* 本字段和URL字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
* 图片二进制文件，最大10MB。
* 使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body中上传即可。
* 使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可。
description.en:
* This field and the URL field are mutually exclusive—you cannot pass through both or leave both empty.  
* Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB in size.  
* When using HTTP invocation, upload the binary file of the image in the HTTP body.  
* When using the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK body.

descriptions.zh:
#### 本接口适用场景 * 阿里云车牌识别，是阿里云官方自研OCR文字识别产品，可有效识别车辆车牌信息，支持多车牌以及多类车型检测识别。 * 阿里云OCR产品基于阿里巴巴达摩院强大的AI技术及海量数据，历经多年沉淀打磨，具有服务稳定、操作简易、实时性高、能力全面等几大优势。 * 本接口图片示例

#### 本接口核心能力 |分类 |概述| |---|---------| |多地区车牌识别|浙、苏、赣、黑、鄂、川、甘、陕、吉、辽、闽、皖等。| |多车型识别|大型汽车、小型汽车、新能源车、挂车、临时车牌、警车、军车、使领馆车、教练车、港澳车。| |使用场景|广泛应用于车辆安防检控、车辆出入识别等场景。| |高精度识别|总体准确率达93%以上。| #### 如何使用本接口 |步骤|概述| |--|---| |1|开通 [车辆物流识别](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_logistics_public_cn) 服务。开通服务前后，您可以通过[体验馆](https://duguang.aliyun.com/experience?type=logistics&subtype=driving_license#intro)免费体验本功能识别效果。| |2|购买[车牌识别资源包](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_logistics_dp_cn&request=%7B%22ord_time%22:%221:Year%22,%22order_num%22:1,%22pack%22:%22ocr_logistics_dp_cn_20211103160032_0692%22,%22flowout_spec%22:%22500%22%7D)。本API会赠送免费额度，可使用免费额度测试。您也可以不购买资源包，系统会通过“[按量付费](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/295347.html)”方式按实际调用量自动扣款。| |3|可以参照[调试页面](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/ocr-api/2021-07-07/RecognizeCarNumber?sdkStyle=dara)提供的代码示例完成API接入开发。接入完成后，调用API获取识别结果。如果使用子账号调用接口，需要阿里云账号（主账号）对RAM账号进行授权。创建RAM用户的具体操作，请参考：[创建RAM用户。](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93720.html)文字识别服务提供一种系统授权策略，即**AliyunOCRFullAccess**。具体授权操作，请参见[在用户页面为RAM用户授权。](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116146.html)| #### 重要提示 |类型|概述| |----|-------------------| |图片格式|
  • 本接口支持：PNG、JPG、JPEG、BMP、GIF、TIFF、WebP。暂不支持PDF格式。
| |图片尺寸|
  • 图片长宽需要大于15像素，小于8192像素。
  • 长宽比需要小于50。
  • 如需达到较好识别效果，建议长宽均大于500px。
| |图片大小|
  • 图片二进制文件不能超过10MB。
  • 图片过大会影响接口响应速度，建议使用小于1.5M图片进行识别，且通过传图片URL的方式调用接口。
| |其他提示|
  • 请保证整张车牌内容及其边缘包含在图像内。
  • 本能力会自动处理反光、扭曲等干扰信息，但会影响精度。请尽量选择清晰度高、无反光、无扭曲的图片。
| |相关能力|
  • [云市场车牌识别。](https://market.aliyun.com/products/57124001/cmapi020094.html?spm=5176.730005.result.17.517535242WwEyb&innerSource=search_%E8%BD%A6%E7%89%8C%E8%AF%86%E5%88%AB#sku=yuncode1409400000)
|
descriptions.en:
#### Scenarios for this API * Alibaba Cloud License Plate Recognition is an official self-developed OCR product that effectively identifies vehicle license plate information and supports detection and recognition of multiple license plates and various vehicle types. * Based on DAMO Academy's advanced AI technologies and massive datasets, Alibaba Cloud OCR has been refined over years to offer stable service, simple operation, high real-time performance, and comprehensive capabilities. * Sample image for this API

#### Core Capabilities of This API |Category |Overview| |---|---------| |Multi-region license plate recognition|Supports regions such as Zhejiang (Zhe), Jiangsu (Su), Jiangxi (Gan), Heilongjiang (Hei), Hubei (E), Sichuan (Chuan), Gansu (Gan), Shaanxi (Shan), Jilin (Ji), Liaoning (Liao), Fujian (Min), and Anhui (Wan).| |Multi-vehicle-type recognition|Supports large vehicles, small vehicles, new energy vehicles, trailers, temporary license plates, police cars, military vehicles, diplomatic vehicles, driving school vehicles, and Hong Kong/Macau vehicles.| |Scenarios|Widely used in scenarios such as vehicle security inspection and access control.| |High-accuracy recognition|Overall accuracy exceeds 93%.| #### How to Use This API |Step|Overview| |--|---| |1|Activate the [Vehicle and Logistics Recognition](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_logistics_public_cn) service. Before or after activation, you can experience this feature for free via the [Experience Center](https://duguang.aliyun.com/experience?type=logistics&subtype=driving_license#intro).| |2|Purchase a [License Plate Recognition resource plan](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_logistics_dp_cn&request=%7B%22ord_time%22:%221:Year%22,%22order_num%22:1,%22pack%22:%22ocr_logistics_dp_cn_20211103160032_0692%22,%22flowout_spec%22:%22500%22%7D). This API includes a free quota for testing. Alternatively, you may choose not to purchase a resource plan; the system will automatically charge based on actual usage under the [pay-as-you-go](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/295347.html) billing model.| |3|Refer to the code samples provided on the [debug page](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/ocr-api/2021-07-07/RecognizeCarNumber?sdkStyle=dara) to integrate the API into your application. After integration, invoke the API to obtain the classification result. If you use a RAM user to call the API, the Alibaba Cloud account (primary account) must grant authorization to the RAM user. For instructions on creating a RAM user, see [Create a RAM user](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93720.html). The OCR service provides a system authorization policy named **AliyunOCRFullAccess**. For details on authorization, see [Grant permissions to a RAM user on the user page](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116146.html).| #### Important Notes |Type|Overview| |----|-------------------| |Image format|
  • This API supports PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, TIFF, and WebP. PDF format is not supported.
| |Image dimensions|
  • Both height and width must be greater than 15 pixels and less than 8192 pixels.
  • The aspect ratio (longer side divided by shorter side) must be less than 50.
  • For optimal recognition results, it is recommended that both height and width exceed 500 pixels.
| |Image size|
  • The binary file size must not exceed 10 MB.
  • Larger images may slow down API response time. We recommend using images smaller than 1.5 MB and invoking the API by passing an image URL.
| |Other tips|
  • Ensure the entire license plate and its edges are fully visible within the image.
  • This capability automatically handles interference such as glare and distortion, though these factors may reduce accuracy. For best results, use high-definition images without glare or distortion.
| |Related capabilities|
  • [Alibaba Cloud Marketplace License Plate Recognition](https://market.aliyun.com/products/57124001/cmapi020094.html?spm=5176.730005.result.17.517535242WwEyb&innerSource=search_%E8%BD%A6%E7%89%8C%E8%AF%86%E5%88%AB#sku=yuncode1409400000).
|
